name: nested comprehension as iterable
code: print([x for x in [i for i in range(3)]])

name: comprehension over call with inner for
for over list comprehension
code:
for x in [i * 2 for i in range(3)]:
    print(x)

name: comprehension containing in keyword
code:
d = {'a': 1}
print([k for k in d if 'a' in k])
